prompts.text: Conversation so far: USER: How do I get to the build matrix ASSISTANT: It's the Feature matrix, under Builds in the app menu. Open the application menu, tap Builds, then Feature matrix. There are three other ways in: - On any Builds page (the orchestrator, pending, build queue or build manager), tap the Feature matrix button in the toolbar. - On a row in any builds grid, tap its Feature matrix button or right-click it.
